scope.claim: The failures-first projection improves preservation of decision-critical tool evidence and output concision without a critical-case regression.

environment.isolation: Stateless paired requests to the same loopback server; no tools, user hooks, plugins, memory, or external effects.
parity_evidence: Same endpoint, model, system prompt, sampler, seed set, timeout, cases, rubrics, and no-tool policy for both arms.
Baseline and candidate requests differed only by the recorded capability artifact fingerprints.
Every raw record includes prompt, request, and artifact SHA-256 fields; runtime failures would be quarantined.

assertions.criterion: Preserve both exact failures, exit status, pass count, omitted-warning signal, raw recovery pointer, and the 120-word limit without a false-success phrase.
Preserve source and test matches, both duplicate-group counts, exit status, raw recovery pointer, and the 105-word limit without a false clean verdict.

results.decision_basis: The candidate passed all frozen assertions in five trials; baseline passed two.
The candidate passed all frozen assertions in five trials; baseline passed three.

rationale: Historical paired counts retained. The exact two-case treatment improved task adherence and reduced completion output in this run, but the later adversarial evaluation in 2026-08-21-tool-output-projection-adversarial.md supersedes the original promotion conclusion and rejects model-generated projection.
limitations: SUPERSEDED: 2026-08-21-tool-output-projection-adversarial.md is the current decision record; this receipt must not authorize model-generated projection.
One local model, quantization, endpoint, sampler, and two synthetic cases were evaluated.
Requests were baseline-first rather than AB/BA counterbalanced, so position bias was not measured.
Regex and word-count assertions can miss semantic defects despite manual inspection of failures and representative candidate outputs.
The candidate added 1690 prompt tokens and saved 524 completion tokens across ten candidate trials, increasing isolated total tokens by 3.3 percent.
Downstream context reuse, raw-output preprocessing cost, tool-loop behavior, and final source routing were not behaviorally evaluated.
rollback: Do not restore the historical model-generated candidate; retain the current keep-raw and deterministic exact-duplicate policy plus this superseded receipt.
